messages:
Anna: Heads-up — the onboarding quickstart in sample-apps/python is still using REDWOOD_API_KEY. New users copying the snippet hit 401s during signup flow. @devex

Kevin: Oof. Which file exactly? Trying to triage quick.

Anna: sample-apps/python/README.md and the JS quickstart block in the same repo. Python shows: 
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
```
Should be REDWOOD_KEY per the env var standard we rolled out last quarter.

Anna: JS section is also inconsistent — fetch example sets header to `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}` while our JS SDK examples show `new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })`. Folks following both get confused.

Sam: Can you paste the JS snippet? I can make a tiny docs PR.

Anna: JS bad snippet: 
```
fetch("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'hi' })
})
```
Recommended SDK usage: 
```
import Redwood from 'redwood-js'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const r = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hi' })
```

docs-bot: Thanks Anna — opened issue #812 for docs triage and labeled it triage/docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/812

Kevin: Opened a mini PR that standardizes to REDWOOD_KEY and replaces raw fetch snippet with SDK constructor example for JS. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/452

Sam: Nice. One more thing — the quickstart text says "SDK retries are enabled" but that's only true for Go/Java. Python/JS require explicit middleware/plugin. We should add a short callout in the quickstart to avoid surprise.

Julia: Agreed. Add a short "Behavior differences" box under Quickstart: e.g., "Note: automatic request retries vary by SDK. See SDK-specific docs for retry configuration." Keep it 1-2 lines.

Kevin: Added the callout and updated CONTRIBUTING.md to document env var name (REDWOOD_KEY) so future copy/paste won't drift. Linked the SDK retry docs.

Sam: Reviewing PR 452 now, will request changes if anything else pops up.

Anna: After Kevin's change merged locally I re-ran onboarding and confirmed quickstart works with REDWOOD_KEY so closing the loop on the 401 issue. Thanks! :raised_hands:

Julia: Small follow-up — we should backport the fix to the onboarding generator template so new sample repos start correct. Created ticket ONB-209 in Linear.

Kevin: Merged PR 452. Marking this thread resolved. :tada:
